_comment: Generators of the final phase (SpecDiff/train.py). gen_full: class/stethoscope/duration-conditional diffusion on the 4,142 official-train cycles; the 30k and 50k EMA checkpoints are used. gen_full_tt: fine-tuned from gen_full ema-30000 with the 2,756 unlabelled test cycles (class = null) mixed in (transductive).
